format: Transparent head-only artwork; WebP delivery at up to 512px with alpha preserved.
shared_prompt: Generate ONE production-ready interchangeable AVATAR HEAD ONLY for a rustic western chess game. The reference sheet defines STYLE ONLY: polished hand-painted collectible game illustration, sculpted dimensional shading, crisp readable face, worn earthy tones, olive, bronze, cream and leather. Subject: SUBJECT. Strict component format: square transparent canvas, absolutely NO torso, shoulders, clothes, hat, glasses, earrings, moustache or beard; only complete head with ears and species features and a short narrow neck ending at bottom. Face front-on, symmetric accessory-compatible pose, no tilted head, no three-quarter perspective. Entire head with features inside x 10%-90%, y 10%-92% of canvas. Face and jaw center x50%; eyes at x36.6% and63.4%, y57%; mouth center x50%, y75%; chin at y90%; forehead crown y25%. Keep these eye, mouth and jaw anchor positions for hats/glasses/moustaches. Natural short hair may be present only as specified for human; animal fur and horns are part of head. Big personality and distinct appealing silhouette, attractive unlockable character, no flat generic SVG look, no blur, no photorealism, no text, no logo, no decorative badge, no background shape. The concept sheet's hats and clothes must NOT be included; they will be composited separately in code. Match the reference painting finish, stylized game art not a photograph. Compact high-detail collectible head, genuine transparent alpha. No built-in facial accessories. Hair should not hide eye anchors.
